description: Companion tools for the standalone oc-twilio-voice service.

port.label: Listen Port
port.help: Must match Twilio webhook config. Default: 3334.

baseUrl.description: Local oc-twilio-voice service base URL. Defaults to http://127.0.0.1:<port>.

publicUrlHost.description: Public hostname used by Twilio webhooks, for status reporting.

callApiToken.description: Bearer token for POST /call. Falls back to CALL_API_TOKEN or OPENCLAW_HOOKS_TOKEN.

defaultAgentId.description: Agent id used for outbound calls when no agentId is supplied.

name: OC Twilio Voice
